Method of Attack: Trojanized installer with malicious DLLs executed on installation
win_fw.dll creates a scheduled task launching idahelper.dll
idahelper.dll connects to devguardmap[.]org to download NukeSped RAT
Remote Access Trojan allows file theft, screenshots, keystroke logging, and command execution
Impacted Systems: Security researchers' devices running pirated IDA Pro
Attack Vector: Trojanized pirated IDA Pro installer distributed online
